versions.changelog:
work2cli-hitl 1.1.0

- 重要设计规范和反模式补充，收紧对接守卫、人工审批与人类可读性的要求
- 全面丰富「反模式」列表，新增卡片可读性与可复制性要求，明确批量审批展示限制
- 完善守卫接入和验收流程，要求真人实际点击卡片、全链路通过才算合格
- 删除 skill-card.md 并调整部分 references 文件内容以配合设计要点更新
- 文档版本号提升为 1.1.0，保持所有文档结构一致与注册表自进化方案对齐

- Initial public release of work2cli-hitl skill.
- Guides users to consolidate routine work into system-organized CLI tools, automatically distinguishing between read/write via agent-led browser-based API reconnaissance.
- All CLI write actions go through a global Feishu HITL ("write-guard") singleton service for approval, offering minimal but unified human-in-the-loop soft control.
- Each successfully created CLI tool automatically appends its usage guide to a self-evolving registry, building up skill documentation over time.
- Clearly outlines boundaries: this is a cooperative safety measure, not a hard security isolation. 
- Includes best practices, anti-patterns, and detailed workflow for phased CLI and HITL orchestration.
